# agentic-forms

Build forms and collect answers into tables.

Keywords: forms,surveys,responses,agents,mcp,cli,tables,collaboration.

- SDK: import { createOps, createFileStore } from "agentic-forms".
- Web UI: the Worker serves /ui/ (build it with npm run build:ui). It signs in with an API token, builds forms, previews, publishes, and reads responses. The UI calls the HTTP API. Each form action in the UI also exists in the SDK, CLI, MCP, or HTTP API.
- UI component: mount(element, { baseUrl, getToken }) from "agentic-forms/ui", with "agentic-forms/ui.css" and "agentic-design/styles.css". It returns { update, unmount }. getToken is called before each request. React 19 is a peer dependency. The pages use the address hash #/forms/<id>.
- Remote SDK: import { createClient, ApiError } from "agentic-forms/client"; createClient({ baseUrl, token, fetch? }) has one method per /api/v1 route plus the public submit. A refused call throws ApiError with status and code. Methods take { signal } last. No retries. It runs in browsers, Workers, and Node 22.
- Account: import { formsAccount } from "agentic-forms/account"; exportAccount(subject, { store }) and eraseAccount(subject, { store }) take subject { id, kind: "human" | "agent" }. Export gives plain JSON of forms, form_versions, responses, grants, and audit. Erase removes the forms the subject alone owns, the subject's grants, and audit rows, and returns counts.
- CLI: agentic-forms --help. share, shares, and unshare give, list, and take away roles through a Worker: set --url (or AGENTIC_FORMS_URL) and AGENTIC_FORMS_TOKEN. invite, invites, link, links, and unlink make and list invites and share links (editor or viewer; a link token shows once).
- MCP: run agentic-forms mcp, then call new_form. list_forms lists every form in the store. With AGENTIC_FORMS_URL and AGENTIC_FORMS_TOKEN set, share_form, list_shares, unshare_form, create_invite, list_invites, create_link, list_links, and revoke_link also exist.
